scope: The two previously untested scenarios, executed against real product scripts with disposable local fake SSH and mate registries; no real hosts.

reproduction.before: COMMAND EXECUTED; status=0; regression failed: invalid remote deadline invalid returned 0 instead of 125
reproduction.root_cause: Invalid explicit settings were silently replaced by the 60-second default.
reproduction.after: Invalid values return 125 with an explicit diagnostic and do not execute the command.

scenarios.name: Partial responses, healthy mates, timeout recovery and queued replies
scenarios.details: Real fm-watch.sh drove fm-on.sh through local SSH fakes. Dead output followed by a stall or exit 255 remained ambiguous, no relaunch or actionable wake occurred, and healthy mates were reached for two cycles. Timeout markers cleared on recovery; another outage logged a fresh episode. A reply queued before transport failure subsequently passed through real remote delta reading, process-event capture, mirroring and acknowledgement.

scenarios.name: Invalid deadline rejection and output/status preservation
scenarios.details: Executed the shared production runner. Invalid inputs invalid, 0, 01, -1, 1.5, 121 and an oversized integer return 125 before side effects. Valid bounds 1 and 120 preserve byte-identical stdout/stderr and statuses 0 and 23.

fixture_limitation: The remote entrypoint disallows homes nested inside its code root. To obey the worktree-only boundary, the disposable reply SSH fake decodes the fm-on protocol and executes the real remote reader locally rather than using the remote job service. This is the explicitly authorized local-fake transport; no real SSH server was exercised.
verification: Only focused cases were executed; no full suite, linters, static analysis, pipeline control, push or CI actions.
